name: SITC2026 S17 - Module C
description: Build a deterministic SwapLoop REST API for a fictional Shanghai e-bike battery swapping and monitored charging pilot. Implement the supplied OpenAPI contract with QR-based access, atomic swap and charging reservations, idempotent service transitions, telemetry-driven safety, subscriptions, role-based authorization, and a resettable compact 13-table MySQL database; verify behaviour with the provided mock feed and conformance tests.
